author: LonelyMan
text_post: Pretty much any of those three is the common trope for these types of rom coms. Silver Linings Playbook was one, i.e. guy and girl don't hit it off at first, slowly become attracted to each other despite their differences, and fall in love to make an unlikely couple. The Tao of Steve is another one, where the lead guy is overweight but has all the women attracted to him. Here, I'm thinking #3 is the ending. Unless the actor in the role actually lost weight for the movie, they'll set up the script that she's attracted to his personality even with a huge girth.
